descriptions.job-1rofe1w:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role 

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

Our mission is to safeguard the company’s assets and our customer’s accounts by relentlessly detecting and investigating fraudulent activities, ensuring the integrity and security of our Bank product.  We champion the prevention and detection of fraud, ensuring the highest standards of security and integrity. 

As a Bank Fraud Investigator, you will be responsible for investigating suspected fraudulent activities within the banking products. You will work closely with various departments to identify, prevent and resolve fraudulent activities involving accounts, transactions and other financial products.

Available shift

  • Tuesday through Saturday; 11:00am – 8:00pm CT and 9am – 6pm CT on Saturdays

This role is based in our Chicago, IL, Westlake, TX and Denver, CO offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Investigate and mitigate bank and credit card fraud by analyzing suspicious activity across multiple payment rails, including debit and credit card transactions, and by reviewing potential identity theft, account takeover (ATO), wire transfer fraud, payment fraud, and check fraud.
  • Analyze financial data, account history, and transaction records to identify irregularities, emerging fraud patterns, and potential policy violations.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including Compliance, Risk, Legal, and Operations, to resolve fraud-related issues, ensure appropriate controls, and escalate cases as required.
  • Conduct outbound contact with customers, merchants, or third parties to perform interviews, gather supporting documentation, and obtain evidence relevant to fraud investigations.
  • Apply Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) requirements when reviewing, documenting, and reporting fraud-related findings, including accuracy, permissible purpose, dispute handling, and adverse action considerations.
  • Maintain current knowledge of fraud typologies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices to support effective prevention, investigation, and response.
  • Ensure investigations and resolutions comply with all applicable regulatory, legal, and internal policy requirements.
  • Clearly, professionally, and timely communicate with customers to deliver an exemplary and compliant customer experience.

What you bring 

  • Proven experience in fraud investigation, financial analysis, or a related role (1-2 years).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Knowledge of fraud operations, regulations, and fraud prevention techniques.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively (written and verbal) with customers and internal teams.
  • Ability to work independently and handle sensitive information with confidentiality and professionalism.
  • Preferred qualifications: Certified in fraud examination (CFE) or a related credential, AML knowledge.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. 
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected hourly range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 2 compensation zones. This role is also eligible to participate in a Robinhood bonus plan.

Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL)
$23—$27 USD
Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL)
$22.10—$26 USD

Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity.

If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application.

Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.
descriptions.job-0s3uuxw:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About The Opportunity

We are currently seeking a Public Cloud Operations Expert to join our Singapore team. You be will responsible for the full lifecycle management of enterprise-level hybrid cloud infrastructure, leading unified orchestration, operations, and cost optimisation of AWS and Alibaba Cloud resources, ensuring high availability, high performance, and compliance.

What You’ll Be Doing 

  1. Cloud Platform Architecture & Operations
    1. Plan, deploy, monitor, and maintain AWS services (EC2, S3, VPC, Lambda, EKS, etc.) and Alibaba Cloud services (ECS, OSS, VPC, Function Compute, ACK, etc.).
    2. Design highly available, auto-scaling cloud architectures, optimizing network (e.g., Alibaba Cloud CEN, AWS Direct Connect), storage, and compute resource configurations.
  2. Monitoring & Incident Management
    1. Implement full-stack monitoring and alerting using cloud-native tools (AWS CloudWatch, Alibaba Cloud CloudMonitor) and open-source solutions (Prometheus+Grafana, ELK).
    2. Lead critical incident response, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventive measures (e.g., resource contention, misconfigurations, network latency).
  3. Cost Optimisation & Resource Management
    1. Analyse cloud resource usage, reduce costs via reserved instances, auto-scaling, and storage lifecycle policies (e.g., AWS S3 Intelligent-Tiering, Alibaba Cloud OSS Archive).
    2. Establish resource quota management strategies to prevent waste and overspending.
  4. Security & Compliance
    1. Implement cloud security baselines (security groups, IAM policies, Alibaba Cloud RAM permissions, AWS Security Hub), conduct regular security audits, and remediate vulnerabilities.
    2. Design granular access controls using AWS IAM and Alibaba Cloud RAM, and enforce database auditing (e.g., AWS CloudTrail + Alibaba Cloud DAS).
  5. Cross-Team Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing
    1. Collaborate with development teams to optimize application architectures and provide cloud-native solutions (Server-less, Microservices).
    2. Document operational procedures (SOP manuals) and lead internal technical training sessions.

What We Look For In You 

  1. Technical Skills
    • Mastery of core services (compute/storage/network/security) on AWS or Alibaba Cloud, with familiarity in the other platform.
    • Proficient in Linux/Windows system operations and automation tools (Shell/Python/Ansible).
    • Hands-on experience with containerized operations (Kubernetes, ECS/EKS, ACK) and cloud-native technologies (e.g., Service Mesh).
  2. Experience Requirements
    • 5+ years of operations experience, with at least 3 years focused on public cloud (AWS/Alibaba Cloud) environments managing 100+ instances.
    • Experience in building cloud platforms from scratch, hybrid cloud architecture design, or large-scale migration projects (e.g., IDC-to-cloud) is preferred.
  3. Team Management
    • Excellent team management and communication skills to lead and collaborate with operations, development, testing, and security teams.
  4. Certifications & Education
    • AWS Certified SysOps Administrator or Alibaba Cloud ACP/ACE certifications are preferred.
    • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Network Engineering, or related fields.

Nice-To-Haves 

  • Familiarity with multi-cloud management platforms (AWS, Alibaba Cloud, Azure) or FinOps cost optimisation methodologies.
  • Experience in cloud security practices, including Web Application Firewall (WAF) and DDoS protection (Alibaba Cloud Anti-DDoS Premium, AWS Shield).
  • Exposure to big data/AI operations (e.g., Alibaba Cloud MaxCompute, AWS EMR).

Perks & Benefits 

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

descriptions.job-18k0yuc:
The Role

We are hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own product marketing for our Platform and Data portfolio, the infrastructure, identity, data and entity-resolution capabilities that power everything else we build, from real-time screening to agentic case remediation. This portfolio includes our migration tooling, which helps customers move off legacy systems onto our Mesh platform, and our emerging agentic and AI capabilities.

You will report to the VP of Product Marketing and be one of two Product Marketing hires building out a newly-forming function. You'll partner closely with the Product Directors who own Platform and Data, translating a strategically-driven, technical roadmap into a competitive narrative and market presence - work that's as much about explaining how we're built and why that matters as it is about a single buyer-facing feature launch.

You'll also be the primary product marketing voice for our US market, our fastest-growing region and own website content and co-marketing with the technology and identity-verification partners that integrate with our platform, alongside competitive intelligence shared across the wider Product Marketing team.

We run a structured, phased launch process that's still evolving - you'll help shape it as you go, deciding what's genuinely differentiated and worth a moment, and what ships quietly as a release note.

This role has no direct reports today. It is a hands-on, individual-contributor role reporting into the VP, with real ownership from day one and room to grow into more scope as the Product Marketing team and the Platform & Data portfolio mature.

What You Will Do

  • Own product marketing for Platform & Data. You are responsible for positioning, messaging, launch execution and enablement for this portfolio, from early roadmap conversations through GA and beyond.
  • Tell the data and platform story. Translate a strategically-driven, technical roadmap - set by the VP Product and Product Directors into a narrative that Sales, analysts and prospects actually understand: why the platform and data layer matter, not just the products built on top of them.
  • Own the migration narrative. Partner with the Migration Tooling squad to build the story and assets that help prospects and customers move off legacy systems onto our platform.
  • Lead launches end to end. Decide what earns a flagship moment versus what ships quietly, and own the launch plan, messaging and positioning brief for the releases that matter most.
  • Own website and partner marketing. Run day-to-day ownership of complyadvantage.com content and co-marketing with the technology and identity-verification partners that integrate with our platform.
  • Contribute to competitive intelligence and win-loss. This is shared across the Product Marketing team for now - you'll help build the muscle until we have dedicated coverage.
  • Represent the US market. You're the voice of our fastest-growing region in company positioning, partnering closely with US sales leadership.
  • Partner with Product without owning their roadmap. You influence priorities through evidence - buyer feedback, competitive dynamics, win-loss signal — not through authority. You operate as a peer to Product Directors, not a downstream recipient of their decisions.
  • Use AI in your own work. We expect Product Marketing to use AI-assisted workflows for research synthesis, competitive analysis, and first-draft positioning and content. This is how we work, not an aspiration.

What We Are Looking For

Essential:

  • 5-8 years of overall professional experience, including 2-4+ years in product marketing
  • Experience at a high-growth, multi-product technology company. Comfortable marketing a portfolio, not a single product
  • Demonstrated ownership of a launch or major narrative/content project end to end - positioning, enablement and go-to-market — with general guidance rather than close oversight
  • Strong independence and autonomy, with good judgment about when to run with something and when to escalate
  • Ability to translate technical, infrastructure-level product capability into a narrative that non-technical audiences — Sales, prospects, analysts — can use
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Comfort operating in a regulated, technical B2B environment, translating product and engineering input into content a commercial audience can act on
  • Demonstrable AI adoption in your own working practice and already using it to work differently, not just interested in it

Preferred:

  • 5-7+ years specifically in product marketing
  • Experience in fintech, security, or identity markets
  • Experience marketing AI or agentic tools, platforms, or features
  • Experience marketing technical or infrastructure/data products, translating engineering-level capability into commercial narrative
  • Familiarity with win-loss and competitive intelligence practices
  • Experience owning or contributing to company website content
  • Experience with partner marketing or co-marketing programs

What Success Looks Like

  • At 60 days: You understand the Platform and Data portfolio, the migration narrative, and our partner ecosystem. You've built working relationships with the Product Directors for Platform and Data, US sales leadership, and the other Product Marketing Lead, and can articulate what's differentiated in this portfolio and why it matters.
  • At 4 months: You are running launches independently through the tiered model for at least one product area. Website content and partner co-marketing have a clear owner and cadence, and you're contributing real signal to the team's competitive intelligence and win-loss picture.
  • At 8 months: You can point to a measurable result from your work — a launch that moved the needle, a partner motion generating real pipeline, or a narrative that's changed how Sales sells the platform. You're a trusted voice in US market planning and operating at a level that could reasonably take on more scope as the team grows.

Benefits

  • Equity as we want you to have a part of what we are building
  • Unlimited Time Off Policy- A work-life balance and focus on our well-being are critical to keeping us performing at our best
  • Annual learning budget to drive your performance and career development
  • Budget to set up your home office upon joining
  • Parental leave and childcare benefits
  • Life Insurance to protect your loved ones
  • Medical (100%), Dental (90%), and Vision (80%) contribution
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) to allow you to use tax free dollars for healthcare or day care related expenses
  • 401k Contribution
  • Financial Perks (Support with student loan, PerkSpot discounts, Pet Insurance discounts, Travel assistance 
  • Pre-Tax transit benefits

The base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $190,000 plus equity, and US benefits. The actual pay may vary based on factors such as location, experience, and skills.

About us

Our mission is to empower every business to eliminate financial crime. 

By harnessing AI, a unified platform, and an extensive partner ecosystem, we help customers turn compliance into a catalyst for growth, operational resilience, and enduring regulatory trust.

More than 3,000 enterprises across 75 countries rely on our end-to-end platform and the world’s most comprehensive financial crime risk intelligence. With full-stack agentic automation, we help organizations automate up to 95% of KYC, AML, and sanctions reviews, cut onboarding times by 50%, reduce false positives by 70%, and handle 7x more work with the same staff.

ComplyAdvantage is headquartered in London and has global hubs in New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and Cluj-Napoca. It is backed by Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan, Goldman Sachs, and Andreessen Horowitz. Learn more about compliance re-engineered for the age of AI at complyadvantage.com.
descriptions.job-0bgvmw4:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's Market Surveillance function is responsible for detecting, investigating and reporting market abuse across our regulated trading venues, spanning spot crypto markets, crypto futures, tokenised equities, OTC markets, and consumer trading. As our licensing footprint and product range grow, so does the scale and complexity of the surveillance programme behind them.

We're hiring a Senior Investigator to take on the function's most complex casework, and help shape how we detect and cover market abuse as the business scales.

 

The opportunity

  • Own complex investigations end to end, writing findings up to a standard a regulator can rely on, and present conclusions to a range of stakeholders.

  • Lead or contribute to periodic threshold and model reviews, recalibrating surveillance rules and alert thresholds as trading behaviour, products and market structure evolve.

  • Support the design, build-out and integration of surveillance platform capability, including onboarding new products, venues and data sources onto the surveillance system.

  • Contribute to market abuse risk assessments, helping identify and score risk across products, jurisdictions and entities, and translate findings into surveillance coverage.

  • Use AI and automation tools responsibly to speed up evidence-gathering, case reconstruction and detection-model development, always with human judgement over the final call.

  • Support conflicts of interest, information barrier, and personal account dealing matters across Markets Compliance, extending beyond surveillance casework where buy-side or asset management experience is directly relevant.

 
 

What you bring

  • Experience investigating market abuse or trading conduct inside a firm subject to market conduct regulation, such as an exchange, broker-dealer, trading venue, or comparable regulated trading business.

  • A track record running investigations end to end, including writing findings up to a standard a regulator can rely on and presenting conclusions to stakeholders.

  • Working knowledge of core market abuse typologies e.g. spoofing, wash trading, insider trading, front running, ramping.

  • Experience with, or strong working knowledge of, threshold and model calibration, surveillance platform integration, market abuse risk assessments, and audit remediation.

  • Comfort using generative AI and other automation tools to improve the speed and quality of investigative work, while maintaining the human oversight regulated casework requires.

  • Familiarity with a surveillance platform (such as Scila, Nasdaq SMARTS, Eventus, or NICE Actimize) and comfort with SQL or a similar query tool for evidence-gathering.

  • Clear, evidence-first written communication - your case files, escalations and regulatory drafts will sometimes be read by auditors and regulators without you in the room to explain them.

  • Exposure to crypto-asset markets is welcomed but not required. What matters most is regulated-market investigation experience; strong candidates from traditional securities or derivatives markets are encouraged to apply.

 
 

Nice to haves

  • E-comms surveillance experience.

 
 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Stay connected

Follow us on Twitter

Learn on the Kraken Blog

Connect on LinkedIn

descriptions.job-17cvobo:
At Breeze, we're building the AI-powered infrastructure layer for global commerce, making it radically simpler for businesses to sell, get paid, and operate across markets.

We go far beyond traditional payment processing. Breeze combines global payments, AI, stablecoins, and a Merchant of Record-like model to take on the complexity businesses typically manage themselves, including compliance, risk, fraud, chargebacks, reconciliation, and customer support.

Our goal is simple: let businesses focus on building and selling great products while Breeze handles the complexity behind getting paid.

Backed by Sequoia Capital, Multicoin Capital, and The Chainsmokers, Breeze is a successful, rapidly growing, and exceptionally well-capitalized company. We have the runway to think long term while remaining early enough that every person joining today can have a meaningful impact on what we build.

Overview

We’re looking for a Senior Account Executive who knows how to turn complex opportunities into meaningful revenue and wants to play a key role in Breeze’s next stage of growth. This is an opportunity to help build out our EU Sales team. 

You’ll own the sales cycle from first conversation through close, building relationships with high-value prospects, breaking into strategic accounts, and helping companies rethink how they move money. This is a role with real ownership and plenty of room to make your mark. You’ll have the autonomy to build your pipeline, shape your approach, and work closely with Product and Marketing to influence how we go to market.

We’re looking for someone with sharp commercial instincts who can build trust quickly, navigate complex deals, and create a compelling reason for customers to choose Breeze.

If you’re a builder and a closer who loves opening doors, winning meaningful business, and helping scale an ambitious fintech, we’d love to meet you.
This role will be hybrid in our Amsterdam office once finalized. 

What You’ll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle from strategic prospecting through close, building pipeline and winning high-value business across the US
  • Break into key accounts through thoughtful outbound strategies that engage the right decision-makers and create new opportunities
  • Turn customer challenges into compelling solutions, tailoring your pitch and positioning Breeze’s value to each prospect’s business
  • Build the case for change, creating urgency, challenging incumbents, and showing prospects why Breeze is the better choice
  • Help shape how Breeze wins, bringing customer and market insights back to Product and Marketing to sharpen our GTM strategy and influence what we build next

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience
  • 5+ years of B2B closing experience, ideally across payments, fintech, gaming, or related technology sectors
  • A proven closer with a track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets and winning complex, high-value mid-market or enterprise deals
  • A strategic seller who can navigate multiple stakeholders, build compelling business cases, create urgency, negotiate effectively, and close at the executive level
  • An exceptional communicator who builds trust quickly and can turn complex solutions into clear, tailored, and compelling pitches
  • A self-starter with startup grit who takes ownership, moves quickly, and adapts as priorities and opportunities evolve

Our Compensation Philosophy!

We believe compensation should be fair, competitive, consistent, and transparent. We benchmark compensation against the market and establish thoughtful bands for each role, with compensation reflecting experience, skills, location, role scope, and expected impact. We don't believe pay should primarily depend on how aggressively someone negotiates. Eligible employees receive meaningful equity, so the people building Breeze can participate in the long-term value they help create.

Benefits & Perks

  • PTO: 21 days, plus applicable company holidays.
  • Equity: Meaningful ownership in the company you're helping build.
  • Equipment: A new MacBook Air and whatever else you need to do your best work.
  • Office & education allowance: An annual budget for your workspace, tools, and professional development.
  • Wellness: A monthly reimbursement to support your well-being.
  • Annual global offsite: We bring the global Breeze team together every year. Previous destinations include Bali and Singapore, with Japan coming next.

Breeze is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion or creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, marital or partnership status, caregiver status, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, height or weight, sexual and reproductive health decisions, status as a victim of domestic violence, sexual violence, or stalking, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Breeze considers qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the New York City Fair Chance Act, where applicable.

Why Join Breeze

  • Make an outsized impact: We're successful and still early, with meaningful traction and strong financial foundations. Lean teams, few layers, and direct access to decision-makers mean you'll have real ownership and the autonomy to make things happen.
  • Solve hard, meaningful problems: Work at the intersection of AI, payments, stablecoins, risk, compliance, financial infrastructure, and global commerce as we build an intelligent infrastructure layer that goes far beyond payments.
  • Build AI-first: AI isn't an add-on. It's central to how we're building our products and how our teams operate. You'll experiment with new tools, automate the repetitive, and continuously rethink how to work smarter.
  • Work with an exceptional team: Join ambitious, curious, low-ego people who move quickly, hold a high bar, and care deeply about what they build.
  • Grow with Breeze: As Breeze grows, strong performers can quickly expand their scope and take on bigger problems.
  • Build for the long term: Backed by Sequoia Capital, Multicoin Capital, and The Chainsmokers, we're exceptionally well-capitalized with the runway to think big.

In-Office Expectations

Employees based in our New York City, NY office follow a hybrid work model and are expected to work from the office three days per week. Employees based in our Singapore office are expected to work on-site five days per week.

In-office expectations may vary slightly depending on role, team, and business needs. Certain roles that require closer cross-functional collaboration or operational support may have additional requirements, which will be discussed during the interview process.

Our approach is designed to support meaningful in-person collaboration, team building, and real-time decision-making while providing flexibility where applicable. We believe this structure enables strong execution, close collaboration, and effective teamwork across our global offices.

Come Build With Us!

We offer a rare combination: the ownership and speed of an early-stage company with the traction, backing, and financial foundations of a successful business.

We're building at the convergence of AI, payments, stablecoins, financial infrastructure, and global commerce. The opportunity is much bigger than building another payment processor.

We're building the intelligent infrastructure layer for global commerce, and there's still an enormous amount left to build.

If you want meaningful ownership, hard problems, exceptional teammates, and the opportunity to help define what comes next, we'd love to hear from you!
descriptions.job-16vyd44:
About Digital Asset & the Canton Network

Digital Asset builds the technologies that are reshaping the foundations of financial markets. Our mission is to create the world’s most trusted, privacy-enabled, and interoperable digital infrastructure for global finance.

At the heart of this mission is the Canton Network - the blockchain purpose-built for institutional finance. Uniquely combining privacy, compliance, and scalability, Canton enables real-time, secure settlement across multiple asset classes. Governed by the Canton Foundation with participation from leading financial institutions, it is the proven link between the promise of blockchain and the power of global finance.

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in New York City, with offices in London, Zurich, Budapest, Hong Kong, and Sydney— we are on a mission to transform finance— and that transformation is now playing out rapidly on the Canton Network.

If you’re interested in playing a crucial role at the intersection of traditional and crypto-capital markets and want to help bring the next trillion dollars of finance on-chain, join us.

About the role:

The Director, Sales - RWA is responsible for driving institutional adoption of tokenization and digital asset infrastructure among financial institutions, asset managers, banks, market infrastructure providers, and enterprise customers. This role combines strategic business development, consultative enterprise selling, and ecosystem engagement to build pipeline, develop client relationships, and deliver revenue growth across Digital Asset’s RWA business.

Responsibilities:

  • Leads complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles from opportunity qualification through commercial execution, working closely with Product, Legal, Engineering, and Customer Success teams
  • Utilizes effective sales strategies to successfully pursue and cultivate leads through building client relationships and supported by deep product knowledge and the ability to translate technical capabilities into measurable business outcomese
  • Professionally institutes practical knowledge of Financial Markets to articulate the solutions that Digital Asset can provide for the benefit and success of client needs
  • Mindfully organizes strategy to meet and supersede targets and satisfy or supersede quota
  • Sets an example for peers and more junior sales professionals in both the cultivation of relationships with key stakeholders and in providing meticulous customer service and attention to detail for utmost client satisfaction 
  • Builds long-term client relationships and expands strategic accounts.
  • Other duties or responsibilities from time to time, as required

What We're Looking For:

  • Experience engaging with global financial institutions and navigating complex procurement, risk, compliance, legal, and operational processes
  • Deep understanding of RWA, capital markets, and institutional financial workflows, including asset tokenization concepts, digital securities, tokenized financial products, and settlement processes
  • Familiarity with institutional adoption trends and market drivers, reconciliation process with multiple counterparties
  • Working knowledge of blockchain and digital assets, including distributed ledger technology, smart contracts, permissioned blockchain platforms, digital wallets, etc.
  • Experience and strong abilities in software enterprise selling methodologies and processes, including ROI analysis, business case development, value-based selling, client qualification, and commercial strategy.
  • Knowledge and strong abilities in business development and sales leadership; anticipates market shifts and positions the company for sustained growth
  • Strong negotiation skills with the ability to achieve favorable commercial outcomes while preserving strong client relationships
  • Builds relationships with strategic ecosystem partners to accelerate adoption of tokenized asset infrastructure.
  • Able to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution, potentially managing multiple opportunities simultaneously
  • Experience and capabilities in business development and strategic account development
  • Excellent communication, including customer communications, executive communications, presentation skills, etc.
  • Demonstrates strong collaboration with Product Management, Marketing, Post-Sales/CX, and Legal

The range below may vary if based outside the New York tri-state area (New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut). Base salaries are determined during our interview process, during which we assess the candidate's experience, skills, and capabilities against internal peers and the scope and responsibilities of the position.

US Pay Transparency

descriptions.job-0mw48v8:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

 

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Kraken's Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, static and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

 

The opportunity

As our Senior Performance Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid creative for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Paid static is the center of the role, but we're hiring a hybrid rather than a specialist: this means you also ideate and create performance video and treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot.

 

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and automation leadership: you set the bar for paid static on the team, work with AI enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with performance creative questions.

  • Own paid static for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.

  • Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform's specs and native feel.

  • Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets, from 9:16 sound-on to static-adjacent 1:1 and 4:5.

  • Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video and imagery, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn't.

  • Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.

  • Version and localize at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you'll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.

  • Build creative that's designed to be tested. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts.

  • Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.

  • Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on.

     

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years in performance creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

  • A portfolio that proves it, submitted with your application. Paid static above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you're able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed.

  • Layout, hierarchy, type and composition that hold up at thumbnail size, in feed, and in multiple languages.

  • Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

  • Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.

  • High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.

  • Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You're fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision.

  • Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic timing and an instinct for what's about to feel dated.

  • Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

  • Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with layouts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements.

  • A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.

  • Figma and Adobe CC (After Effects, Premiere, Photoshop) as well as strong genAI skills

  • Curious about investing and crypto at a minimum, and able to make the space legible to others.

descriptions.job-1cblmhw:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work directly with TRM's national-security customers — deploying our platform into their environments, sitting with the people who use it, and building what the mission actually needs.

This is a generalist engineering role. In a given quarter you might ship application code, debug a Kubernetes workload in a restricted environment, design a data schema, stand up cloud infrastructure, or prototype an entirely new capability because a customer described a problem nobody has solved yet. You will often be the only TRM engineer in the room. What you build enables our government customers to use TRM securely in the most demanding environments in the world — and carries what you learn there back into the product.

The impact you will have:

  1. Deploy, integrate and operate TRM's platform inside customer environments - cloud and air-gapped - and own the outcome, not just your slice of it.

  2. Sit directly with mission users, translate what they need into working software, and build it: integrations, data pipelines, and prototypes that prove out a capability before it's a product.

  3. Deliver across whatever the problem requires — application code, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, databases, data flow - rather than staying inside one specialty.

  4. Act as the technical bridge back to TRM's product and engineering teams, carrying mission context into the roadmap.

  5. Diagnose and resolve hard problems in constrained environments, with limited tooling and limited outside help.

What we’re looking for:

  • Strong programming ability in Python and/or Node.js/TypeScript, with real fluency developing with AI — coding agents and LLM tooling are part of how you ship, and you have judgment about where they help and where they don't.

  • Hands-on Kubernetes: deploying, debugging and reasoning about real workloads. Maintaining someone else's cluster is not the same thing.

  • Production AWS experience — building environments, not just consuming them.

  • Working fluency with relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar): schema design, query tuning, moving data around safely.

  • Range. Concrete examples of delivering outside your primary specialty — a new language, datastore or platform you picked up because the project needed it.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication. You will be the only engineer in front of a customer regularly, and comfort there is not optional.

Bonus, not required — depth in any of these raises the bar

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform) and GitOps (Argo CD)

  • Data engineering at scale — orchestration, streaming, columnar/analytics stores

  • Distributed systems design and debugging

  • Building machine learning or agentic systems

  • Deep Linux/Unix and networking, especially in restricted or disconnected environments

  • Prior delivery inside classified or otherwise regulated government environments

About the Team:

  • Small, senior and high-trust. Everyone owns a real surface end to end; nobody is handed a queue of tickets.

  • We are the closest team at TRM to our customers, and we put them first. We do what it takes for their mission to succeed.

  • We align to US-eastern hours, on-site and remote, and we communicate across a lot of channels — high-side chat, high-side and low-side email, Slack, phone, Signal, Google Meet — switching between them fast when the situation calls for it.

  • Weekly team syncs plus project check-ins. We keep tracking current in Linear and raise problems the moment we see them rather than at the next standup.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Rapid issue resolution. FDEs identify and diagnose critical on-site issues, open an incident channel or virtual war room with the remote team, and land fixes in minutes to hours — then run the retro and share the lesson with internal and customer stakeholders within 48 hours.

  • Navigating bureaucratic hurdles. FDEs anticipate customer-side delays rather than absorbing them: building relationships with customer stakeholders, finding the bottleneck, and finding another path to approval. Weeks of waiting become days.

  • Efficient knowledge transfer. Documentation stays current in Notion and work stays current in Linear. Anything that threatens a milestone is flagged within 24 hours, so the remote team is never surprised.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered.

What to Expect From Our Interview Process

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Typically 3–5 interviews to go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact.

  • Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions.

  • Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding.

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

Learn more about interviewing at TRM

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate

  • Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more about Interviewing at TRM

 

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. Learn more about building tools for defenders.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide.

The world of digital assets is accelerating in speed, magnitude, and complexity, opening the door to new ways for leveraging the blockchain. Fireblocks’ platform and network provide the simplest and most secure way for companies to work with digital assets and is trusted by some of the largest financial institutions, banks, globally-recognized brands, and Web3 companies in the world, including BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Revolut, and thousands more.

About the Role

Fireblocks is expanding its security organization to meet the risks and opportunities created by the rapid adoption of AI — both inside the company and across our platform. As our AI Security Engineer, you will own the security lens on AI at Fireblocks: tracking the fast-moving external AI threat landscape, assessing how AI is actually being used across the company — in our platform, by developers, by corporate and business users, and through procured AI tools — and architecting and building the controls, infrastructure, and tooling that keep that usage secure.

This is a hands-on, builder-focused role. You won’t just recommend solutions — you will design, implement, and operate them, working closely with Security, R&D, and other stakeholders across the business. You’ll also research how open-weight models can be put to work for us, building tooling that helps our incident response teams investigate and respond to threats in real time.

What You’ll Do

AI Risk Research & Landscape Monitoring

  • Track new developments, capabilities, and attack techniques in the AI space, and translate them into concrete risks for Fireblocks.
  • Build and maintain a living threat model for AI usage across the company, covering the platform, internal tooling, and third-party AI services.

AI Usage Discovery & Risk Assessment

  • Analyze how AI is used across Fireblocks — in the platform, by developers (e.g., coding assistants), by corporate and business users, and through AI tools brought in via procurement.
  • Assess the configuration and security posture of AI systems and tools in use, and identify and prioritize gaps.

AI Security Architecture & Tooling

  • Design and propose new tooling, configurations, and projects that reduce AI-related risk.
  • Architect and implement the resulting solutions end-to-end, partnering with engineering teams where needed.
  • Build and operate the AI security infrastructure that makes AI usage across Fireblocks secure by default.

Open-Weight Models for Security Operations

  • Research open-weight model implementations for use in security workflows.
  • Deploy open-weight models to support the incident response teams in investigating and responding to security incidents in real time.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3+ years of experience spanning AI/ML, with hands-on exposure to both.\
  • 3+ years of experience in engineering / RnD roles. 
  • Strong knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS in particular) and how AI workloads run in production.
  • Strong understanding of AI/ML system architecture — model deployment, inference infrastructure, RAG, pipelines, and agent frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and rolling out leading AI tools and platforms for a broad internal audience.
  • Experience working with open-weight/open-source models in production or research settings.
  • A genuine builder mentality — a track record of designing, shipping, and operating security tooling or infrastructure end-to-end, not just advising on it.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently while coordinating closely with Security, R&D, and other stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with AI security frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, NIST AI RMF, or MITRE ATLAS.
  • Experience with SOC/IR tooling, threat intelligence, or offensive security.

descriptions.job-1mqz3c4:
About Us

Socket helps devs and security teams ship faster by cutting out security busywork. Thousands of orgs use Socket to safely find, audit, and manage open source code. Our customers - from Anthropic to xAI, and Figma to Vercel - love Socket (just check out their tweets to see for yourself!)


Founded by Feross Aboukhadijeh, a long-time open source maintainer with software downloaded over a billion times a month, Socket has raised $125M in funding from top angels, operators, and security leaders.

About the Role

You'll own customer success post-sale, working specifically with large enterprise accounts that have complex technical environments and dependency ecosystems. That means understanding how each customer wants to use Socket, helping them get there, and solving problems when things break.

This is a product-focused, technical role. You'll spend your time learning customer environments, asking the right questions to uncover blockers, and translating product capabilities into solutions. You're also the front line for technical support. We don't have a separate support team. When something doesn't work as expected, you investigate.

AEs own renewals and expansion. You own making the customer successful with the product.

What You'll Do

Account Management

  • Own post sales relationship as the main point of contact and technical advisor

  • Strategize with AEs on upsells, renewals and expansions

  • Relationship building and executive alignment with our Champions

  • Conducting Quarterly Business Reviews with strategic customers

  • Build measurable customer success plans

Onboarding & Implementation

  • Lead technical onboarding for new enterprise customers, from initial setup through full integration

  • Work with engineering teams to configure Socket across CI/CD systems, build pipelines, IDEs, and internal tooling

  • Build repeatable onboarding playbooks, scripts, and automations that reduce time-to-value

Technical Troubleshooting

  • Investigate and resolve integration, configuration, and compatibility issues

  • Respond to customer issues in dedicated Slack channels

  • Use logs and telemetry to identify root causes and document fixes

  • Escalate to Engineering when needed and follow through to resolution

Product Enablement

  • Run discovery conversations to understand customer goals and use cases

  • Translate complex product capabilities into practical, developer-friendly guidance

  • Conduct architecture reviews and security posture assessments

  • Deliver workshops, office hours, and deep-dives that drive adoption

Customer Advocacy

  • Bring technical feedback and field intelligence back to Product and Engineering

  • Surface patterns that inform roadmap priorities

  • Contribute documentation and internal tooling to scale the Technical Success practice

What You'll Bring

  • 4+ years in a technical customer-facing role (Solutions Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Support Engineer, or similar)

  • 2+ years of experience being the dedicated point of contact for customers with an emphasis on quarterly health checks and success

  • Background in Socket's key product areas: Application Security, DevSecOps, package managers, or open-source ecosystems OR Linux systems administration, networking, firewalls, and Docker

  • Experience with developer tooling and CI/CD platforms (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI, etc.)

  • Ability to read and reason about code (JavaScript, Python, TypeScript)

  • Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, and SaaS integration patterns

  • Comfort troubleshooting in production environments alongside engineering teams

  • Clear written and verbal communication with developers, security practitioners, and executives

  • Willingness to travel for customer and company meetings as needed

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing large enterprise accounts with complex technical environments and dependency ecosystems

  • Experience with SCA, dependency management, or security scanning tools

  • Contributions to open-source projects

Tools You'll Use

Slack, GitHub, Zendesk, Vitally, HubSpot, Grafana

Our Interview Process

  1. Informational call with someone from our Talent team

  2. Virtual f2f with technical leadership

  3. Virtual f2f with a peer

  4. Presentation

  5. Final interview with our Founder & CEO

  6. References

  7. Decision

Hiring is a big decision on both sides. Read more about our Hiring Philosophy and how we approach the process at Socket.

Benefits: Our benefits are crafted to support you and your family, so you can take care of what matters most and thrive in and outside of work. We offer:

  • Market competitive salary bands

  • Meaningful equity program

  • Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family (99% coverage)

  • Flexible time-off, holidays, and winter shutdown to rest & recharge

  • Paid parental leave

  • Remote-first, with quarterly team off-sites

At Socket, we

  1. Pursue Excellence: We set ourselves apart by consistently delivering work of exceptional quality and distinction.

  2. Move with urgency and focus: We prioritize swift, decisive action.

  3. Think rigorously: We care about being right and it often takes reasoning from first principles to get there. We value alternative perspectives and have constructive discussions.

  4. Trust and amplify: We overtrust, always assume good intent, and give specific feedback to help each other improve.

  5. Feel a strong sense of ownership: We wear many hats and feel a strong sense of overall ownership of the company and we're non-territorial regarding our nominal domains.

  6. Are customer obsessed: We relentlessly prioritize the needs of our customers, striving to exceed their expectations and delight them at every interaction.
descriptions.job-0m8enj8:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

The Virtualization team provides scalable on-premises compute for DRW’s trading desks, data scientists, and enterprise application teams. Our goal is to enable teams to keep focused on their business goals by providing simple, scalable solutions with off the shelf tools and the right amount of focused engineering. We're looking for a Senior Engineer for our Virtualization team who will help guide the design and implementation of a new OpenStack-based virtualization platform. In this role you will help guide key architectural decisions for this platform, set engineering standards, identify and eliminate risks, and ensure optimal performance and cost-efficiency.

Our philosophy:

  • We believe in relentless automation of repetitive tasks.
  • We have the curiosity and drive to dig deep and find creative solutions.
  • We believe our goal is to find the right solution rather than always being right.
  • We provide exceptional customer service to our teams and trading desks.
  • We care more that the right thing is done than about rigid job descriptions or boundaries.

What you’ll do:

  • Own and improve infrastructure, processes, and standards for DRW’s Virtualization platform.
  • Relentlessly automate repetitive manual tasks.
  • Design, implement, and manage OpenStack clouds, including deployment, configuration, and maintenance of OpenStack components.
  • Diagnose and rectify complex problems involving multiple teams related to OpenStack including compute, storage, and networking issues.
  • Provide exceptional customer service to our platform’s users.
  • Coach engineers on best practices, help investigate outages, set a high standard for operational and technical excellence.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and resolve critical production issues in a high-intensity trading environment as part of an on-call rotation.

Your background:

  • Expert level proficiency in administration of OpenStack.
  • Deep knowledge of networking, storage, Linux, and virtualization fundamentals.
  • Proficiency with industry-standard IAC tooling (e.g. Terraform, Ansible).
  • Scripting/Coding experience in multiple languages (e.g. Python, Golang, Bash).
  • Experience maintaining/deploying/configuring server hardware and deploying virtual machines.
  • A service focused attitude: you ask questions and focus on getting the right resources and solutions to people instead of rigid boundaries.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. You can work across teams and have evidence-based discussions on technical and operational topics.
  • You enjoy leading by example. You cultivate technical excellence and soft skills in your team members.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with VMWare ESXi.
  • Experience with Containerization / Kubernetes.
  • Experience administering on-premise infrastructure.
  • Experience developing, deploying, and supporting full stack web applications.
  • Experience with multiple programming languages in both greenfield development and legacy maintenance.

The annual base salary range for this position is $220,000 to $280,000 depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. The position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition, DRW offers a comprehensive suite of employee benefits including group medical, pharmacy, dental and vision insurance, 401k (with discretionary employer match), short and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, health savings accounts, and flexible spending accounts.

For more information about DRW's processing activities and our use of job applicants' data, please view our Privacy Notice at https://drw.com/privacy-notice.

California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice.

descriptions.job-0lu02p0:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Team

The Compliance function at OKX is responsible for promoting a strong compliance culture and supporting the business in meeting its regulatory obligations and managing enterprise risk.

The Product Compliance team is responsible for embedding compliance into the product lifecycle and supporting the compliant development, launch and ongoing operation of OKX products and features globally across all markets in which our products and services are offered. We work closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, Central Compliance and local Compliance teams to identify regulatory and compliance requirements, assess product risks and develop practical solutions that support responsible commercial growth.

About the Opportunity

 We are seeking an experienced, hands-on and commercially minded Senior Compliance Manager to join our Product Compliance team.

This is a senior individual-contributor role focused primarily on the day-to-day review of new products, material product changes and existing product enhancements. The emphasis is on delivering timely, well-reasoned product compliance assessments using a risk-based approach, ensuring that material compliance risks are sufficiently mitigated and the firm’s regulatory positioning protected.

You will act as a trusted compliance partner throughout the product development lifecycle, helping Product and Engineering teams navigate complex regulatory requirements while enabling commercially viable outcomes. You will be expected to distinguish between legal or regulatory constraints that cannot be crossed, risks that can be addressed through proportionate controls, and residual risks that require documented escalation or risk acceptance.

 

What You’ll Be Doing

    • Own and deliver day-to-day compliance reviews of new products, features, market expansions and material changes to existing products across OKX's global business and product suite.
    • Review product requirements, technical documentation, user journeys, onboarding flows, trading or transaction mechanics, reward structures, disclosures and operational processes.
    • Apply a risk-based waterfall that distinguishes hard legal or regulatory blockers from risks that may be addressed through controls, product conditions, jurisdictional restrictions, monitoring or escalation.
    • Conduct and document product compliance risk assessments covering areas such as regulatory perimeter and licensing, AML/CFT, sanctions, KYC, consumer protection, financial promotions, trading and market conduct, asset safeguarding, data privacy and third-party risk.
    • Produce clear, concise and evidence-based and solutions-based compliance recommendations setting out identified risks, required mitigants, residual exposure and the proposed approval or escalation route.
    • Work directly with Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, Central Compliance and local Compliance teams to develop practical and scalable solutions to identified compliance requirements.
    • Maintain complete and accurate documentation and audit trails for product reviews, decisions, conditions, exceptions, approvals and subsequent changes.
    • Support post-launch monitoring, control testing and assurance in partnership with Audit, Product and other Compliance teams, and drive remediation of identified issues.
    • Promote a compliance-by-design culture within the product lifecycle; communicate the Product Compliance framework and program requirements to relevant stakeholders and deliver targeted training or guidance to Product, Engineering and business teams as required.
    • Support special projects and priority product launches in a fast-paced and continually evolving environment.
 

What We Look For In You

    • At least 8 years of relevant experience in Compliance, Legal or Risk within financial services, fintech, payments or the cryptocurrency industry.
    • Bachelor's degree in law, finance, business, economics, engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
    • Significant hands-on experience in product compliance, regulatory advisory or product risk assessment, including advising on new products and material product changes.
    • Strong understanding of the digital-asset industry and the products offered by crypto platforms, including trading, custody, payments, staking or earn products, lending, structured products, wallets or DeFi.
    • Strong working knowledge of relevant regulatory and compliance requirements, including licensing and regulatory-perimeter considerations, AML/CFT, sanctions, KYC, consumer protection, financial promotions and trading or market-conduct requirements.
    • Demonstrated ability to analyze products or initiatives involving significant complexity and risk and translate regulatory requirements into practical product requirements and controls.
    • Experience in and demonstrated success in leveraging AI-enabled technology to maintain risk assessment standards, including ongoing tuning of agentic skills aligned with the Company’s risk appetite.
    • Excellent risk judgment and the ability to balance compliance rigor with a pragmatic, risk-based approach that supports responsible commercial outcomes.
    • Proven ability to develop and deliver repeatable product compliance solutions, controls and review processes aligned with broader group requirements.
    • Strong project-management and execution skills, including the ability to manage multiple concurrent reviews, maintain accurate documentation and meet product-launch deadlines.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clear recommendations and lead discussions with Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, senior management and other Compliance stakeholders.
    • Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to influence product decisions and constructively challenge proposals without compromising Compliance rigor.
    • Self-motivated, proactive and comfortable operating independently within a fast-paced, globally dispersed team.
    • High personal integrity and sound professional judgment, including the ability to identify when an issue requires escalation.
 

Nice to Haves

    • Direct product compliance or regulatory advisory experience at a crypto exchange, fintech or technology-led financial-services company.
    • Experience supporting multi-jurisdictional product launches and applying regulatory requirements across the United States, European Union, Middle East or Asia-Pacific.
    • Practical knowledge of CeFi trading products, including spot, derivatives, leverage, custody, institutional products and OTC flows.
    • Familiarity with Web3 products, blockchain technology, smart contracts, DeFi protocols and digital-asset transaction flows.
    • Experience developing compliance risk-assessment frameworks, controls, and key risk indicators.
 

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances 
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants 
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!
